messages:
tess: Heads-up  telemetry shows elevated 503/504s across eu-west and a partial control-plane failover. Deploybot auto-paused the 09:00 release slot. Confirming emergency hold and quick mitigation plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] paused release slot 2026-03-12T09:00Z due to cross-region ingress error increase > threshold. Paused window: 09:00-09:45. Trigger: control-plane failover events + ingress 5xx spike.

hiro: Confirmed hold. Suggest we: 1) DO_NOT_REQUEUE the 09:00 slot 2) pin canary to last-known-good (v3.2.0) 3) create a new tentative slot at 20:00 with micro-stagger to let infra fully stabilize.

mike: Correlating logs now; saw an API gateway rollout and a traffic-shaper rollout yesterday. My hunch: traffic-shaper introduced a new connection drain heuristic. Recommend disabling the new shaper on edge canaries and rolling back the gateway patch if metrics don't improve.

platform-oncall: Oncall here  we can patch canaries only: `kubectl set env ds/gateway GATEWAY_DRAIN=legacy -n edge` and `kubectl patch cm traffic-shaper -p '{"data":{"drain-mode":"off"}}'` Doing it now, ETA ~12m.

release-coordinator: I'll pin the slot and add release note: `releasectl pin --slot 09:00 --version v3.2.0 --reason "incident hold - cross-region ingress spike"` and `releasectl note --slot 09:00 --append "Paused due to ingress spike; DO_NOT_REQUEUE; pinned to v3.2.0"`. Also opening a calendar tentative at 2026-03-12T20:00Z with 2m micro-stagger.

tess: Drafted customer blurb: "We observed elevated request errors impacting EU region. Scheduled releases are paused while engineers investigate. We'll update in 30 minutes or on resolution." Posting to #ops-status + support templates.

mike: Patch applied to canaries; gateway env set to legacy. Early signal: 5xx down ~30% on canaries after 6m. Still watching downstream latencies and control-plane event queue.

platform-oncall: Control-plane event rate has slowed; no new failovers in last 8m. Keeping watch for 20m. If errors don't drop to baseline we escalate to networking infra for TCP resets tracing.

deploy-bot: Tentative slot created: 2026-03-12T20:00Z (micro-stagger 2m). Backfill rules: emergency hotfixes and documentation only. Original slot 09:00 flagged DO_NOT_REQUEUE.

hiro: Action recap: tess = customer comms + ops-status; mike = rollback/patch on canaries + metrics; platform-oncall = monitor & escalate; release-coordinator = pin, note, tentative slot. Check-in in 25m here.

tess: Added incident ticket link and postmortem placeholder in the release notes. Also flagged the change log so release schedulers won't requeue accidentally.

mike: Metrics trending better; 5xx down ~60% on canaries; aggregate still slightly elevated. I'll keep tracing open and attach spans.

platform-oncall: No new infra alarms; recommending keeping slot paused until end-of-day if anything non-baseline persists. Will escalate if spike returns.

release-coordinator: Reminder to teams: do not manually requeue the 09:00 slot. Use the tentative 20:00 slot and follow micro-stagger. Also include the incident id in any backfill notes.

tess: Thanks all. Reconvene here in 25 minutes or earlier if anything changes.
